_comment: Approved sources of manager-authored public writing for the letters research product.
Phase 0 (discovery only). Every active record is an SEC-hosted route: the filings a fund
or its registered fund files with EDGAR. Manager websites whose terms of use restrict
automated retrieval are recorded under 'excluded' with the reason, and are never fetched.
A source may be 'active' only when retrievalMode is 'automated_sec' and rightsJudgement is
'sec_public_record'. scripts/discover-letters.mjs refuses to run otherwise. One request per
active source per run: the filer's submissions index on data.sec.gov. Nothing else is read.
The CIKs for the three registered funds were written from memory and are checked against the
entity name EDGAR returns before a single filing is listed; a mismatch stops the run.
Filing index URLs are authoritative. A DFAN14A or Schedule 13D is stored under the subject
company's CIK folder, which the submissions index does not name, so no document URL is ever
inferred from the filer's CIK; enumerate-letters.mjs reads the folder off the index page.
Edit this file, not the script.

sources.rightsNote: Filed with the SEC and public. The exhibit's author keeps copyright; display is excerpt-only with a link to sec.gov.
sources.note: Presentations also sit on starboardvalue.com; its general terms page was not located, so the site is paused, not used.

sources.rightsNote: As above. elliottmgmt.com publishes nothing outside an investor portal; campaign microsites are not approved.
The shareholder report filed by the trust carries the manager's letter. southeasternasset.com is terms-silent on automation and is not used until further approval.
The trust's report carries one commentary section per fund. oakmark.com's terms bar robots and copying; the site is excluded.
The fund's report carries the shareholder letter. sequoiafund.com's terms bar scraping and mirroring; the site is excluded.

excluded.reason: Terms of use bar spidering, screen scraping and automated retrieval; personal, non-commercial use only; click-through gate. No SEC-filed copy exists. Not in Phase 0 by decision.
Terms bar any robot, spider or intelligent agent and restrict to personal, non-commercial use. The same commentary is inside the trust's N-CSR on EDGAR.
Terms bar scraping, data mining, mirroring and deep linking; personal, non-commercial use. The shareholder letter is inside the fund's N-CSR on EDGAR.
Letters described as reserved for clients; not fetched, unverified.
Terms silent on automation; robots open. Treated as requiring an SEC source or further approval. The N-CSR route is used instead.
General terms page not located within the review budget; only a privacy notice found. Paused until terms are read.
No public letters; investor portal only. Campaign microsites not reviewed.
Domain redirects to an unrelated site; current host unverified. Not in Phase 0.
